name: Provisions on the Administration of Algorithm Recommendation for Internet Information Services
description: China's first dedicated algorithm-governance regulation, grounded in the CSL, DSL, and PIPL. Regulates recommendation-algorithm use in internet information services (search, feeds, e-commerce, gig platforms): requires algorithm filing/registration with CAC for services with public-opinion or social-mobilization capability, mandates user opt-out/control over recommendation profiling, bans algorithmic price discrimination, and requires labor-rights protections for algorithm-managed gig workers. Jointly issued by CAC, MIIT, MPS, and SAMR.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn).
